name: Relevium Critical Call Flags
description: Business-critical alerts detected on calls. These are not agent skill fails by default — they surface urgent follow-up situations.

flags.label: New patient — no attorney
flags.description: Trigger when the caller is a new patient / establishing care and clearly states they do not have an attorney, lawyer, or legal representation. Do not trigger solely because attorney status was never mentioned.

flags.label: Procedure declined
flags.description: Trigger when the practice is calling about (or offering) a procedure/injection/surgery and the patient declines, refuses, postpones indefinitely, or cancels that procedure. Do not trigger for routine appointment cancelations unrelated to a procedure.
